# Gexus

> Gexus is an AI native CAD platform. You describe the part you need in plain
> language and Gexus returns a manufacturable design, with topology, stress
> results and a machining plan attached.

## What it does

- Turns a written brief into real geometry. You state the loads, the material
  and the envelope; Gexus proposes several designs and explains the tradeoff
  behind each one.
- Optimises topology against how the material actually behaves, not against a
  visual style.
- Runs stress analysis on the result so the numbers arrive with the shape.
- Checks manufacturability against the processes and machines a team already
  owns, covering machining, printing and moulding.
- Learns from the designs a team ships, so later work benefits from earlier
  work.

## Who it is for

Mechanical, aerospace, robotics and powertrain teams who need parts that have
not been built before, and who care as much about whether a part can be made
as about whether it looks right.

## Product pillars

- Engineering Intelligence: understands load paths, material behaviour and
  failure modes.
- Design Reasoning: weighs tradeoffs and commits to a choice.
- Manufacturing Aware: proposes only geometry that can actually be produced.
- Continuously Learning: improves with every design a team completes.

## Workflow

Concept, Design, Simulate, Manufacture, Validate. One continuous thread with
no exports or rebuilds between stages.
